bundle.description: Topo, 1.5 m satellite imagery, 30 m relief and contours, forest stands inferred from the national forest maps, burns, water, game management subzones, First Nation settlement land, and the habitat, wind and going grids around Highland Lake; no 1 m LiDAR here.

forest.attribution: Forest inferred from SCANFI and CanLaD © Natural Resources Canada

basemap.missing: not baked: the map draws the live NRCan base map

topo.source: Toporama hypsography (contours and spot heights), NRCan WMS

satellite.source: Yukon SPOT 1.5 m colour composite, Geomatics Yukon ImageServer

hillshadeLidar.missing: no 1 m LiDAR here: the nearest HRDEM survey is tens of km away

dem.source: MRDEM 30 m, with HRDEM 1 m LiDAR over the core (mrdem-30), NRCan

contours.missing: no 1 m LiDAR here: the MRDEM's contours stand in

forest.source: inferred from SCANFI v2 (species, closure, height, age, 30 m) and CanLaD v1.1 (cuts and burns), Canadian Forest Service

bathy.missing: Ontario only: lake depths need the ARA lake facts and the MNR sheets

bathySheets.missing: Ontario only: MNR lake survey sheets

places.source: GeoYukon: game management subzones, First Nation settlement land, burns and roads

wmu.source: Game Management Areas 250k (subzones), GeoYukon; generalised, not for legal use

camps.missing: Ontario only: Crown land camps come from LIO

parks.missing: none baked for the Yukon yet

bathy.missing: Ontario only: lake bathymetry comes from LIO

fire.source: Yukon fire history, Wildland Fire Management, GeoYukon

roads.source: Yukon Road Network and surface disturbance lines (access roads, trails, cut lines), GeoYukon

forest.missing: not in the maps as GeoJSON: the map reads the stands from the forest tiles, and the GeoJSON stays the bake's input

depth.missing: Ontario only: lake depths need the ARA lake facts and the MNR sheets

habitat.source: derived: MRDEM, NRCan 2020 land cover, forest stands, water, wetlands, roads and burns

micro.source: derived: the habitat grid and the MRDEM

going.source: derived: HRDEM LiDAR, point-cloud bush or the forest-map estimate, water, wetlands and roads
